hud.silence_warn: ⚠ silence — the mic does not hear you (pick the device in the tray)
hud.privacy_hint: privacy mode — the text is hidden, the level stays
notify.not_recognized: (not recognized — speak closer to the mic)
notify.copied: Window changed — the text is in the clipboard, paste it manually
focus.changed: The window you were dictating into is no longer active. Where should the text go?
notify.wait_cycle: Wait for the current cycle to finish
notify.stop_before_device: Stop recording before changing the device
notify.device_next: The device applies to the next recording
notify.hotkey_failed: The new hotkey did not start — the previous one stays: {combo}
notify.update_latest: You are on the latest version: {ver}
notify.update_found: New release {ver} is available — update from the tray menu
notify.update_installed: VibeForma {ver} installed — restart from the tray menu
notify.update_refused: Update refused: integrity check failed (details in the log)
notify.update_later: New release {ver} — I will update after the current cycle
settings.title: VibeForma settings
settings.note_silence: silence in speech that closes the phrase and inserts the text
settings.autostop: auto-stop on silence (off — stop only by hotkey again)
settings.note_partial: how often the panel refreshes the recognized text while you speak
settings.note_alpha: the slider changes transparency immediately; Save remembers it
settings.autogrow: window grows with text (off — fixed height)
settings.restore: restore the old clipboard 1 s after pasting
settings.confirm_focus: ask where to paste if the window changed during dictation
settings.exclude_history: keep the inserted text out of Windows clipboard history
settings.note_exclude_history: Windows 10+ also keeps it out of cloud sync; on other systems the clipboard manager may still save the text
settings.notify_text: show the dictated text in notifications (off — only the character count)
settings.note_recog: the model recognizes exactly this language — switch in the tray or here
settings.note_ui: shipped: en, ru — drop a JSON file into app/locales to add more
settings.autostart_w: start the service when Windows starts
dictionary.note: Terms are added to the recognition prompt; replacements are applied after recognition. Matching ignores case, the longest term wins, and Save applies the list.
dictionary.preview_none: Type a sample text to check the replacements.
dictionary.no_from: Enter the term as it is recognized.
dictionary.bad_file: Could not read the file. Open the logs folder from the tray for details.
history.enable: keep a local history of dictations
history.app: remember the app name for each entry
history.note: Stored only on this computer, at most {n} entries; turning history off deletes the file. The dictated text is never written to the log.
history.disabled: History is off — entries are not stored.
history.clear_question: Delete all history entries from this computer?
history.paste_again_hint: The text is in the clipboard — switch to the target window and press Ctrl+V
history.undo_other_window: The window changed — undo skipped, the text is untouched
history.undo_late: More than 30 s passed — undo skipped, use Ctrl+Z in the app yourself
history.restore_none: The previous clipboard content is unknown
model.keep: keep the previous model on disk (fast switching back)
models.desc.large-v3: large-v3 — 3.1 GB, top accuracy, slower (≈1.5 s per 12 s phrase on an RTX GPU)
models.desc.large-v3-turbo: large-v3-turbo — 1.6 GB, near large-v3 accuracy, ~2.4× faster (recommended)
models.desc.medium: medium — 1.5 GB, weaker on complex speech, faster than large
models.desc.small: small — 0.5 GB, for weak hardware, lowest accuracy
dlg.phase_busy: A dictation cycle is running — wait for it to finish and try again.
dlg.cache_note: The previous model lives in the shared cache and was kept.
onboarding.title: VibeForma setup
onboarding.step1_note: The model recognizes exactly the language you pick; the interface follows Windows when set to auto.
onboarding.test_hint: Say a short phrase — the text appears here and is not inserted anywhere.
onboarding.test_empty: No speech heard — try again or pick another device.
onboarding.test_wait: Wait until the model is ready — the test needs it.
onboarding.hotkey_note: Press the combination you want: modifiers alone are not enough; at least one key is required.
onboarding.capture: Press the combination now (Esc to cancel)…
onboarding.hotkey_invalid: This combination is not valid — use one key, optionally with modifiers.
onboarding.hotkey_modifiers_only: Modifiers alone cannot be a hotkey.
onboarding.hotkey_conflict: Windows may already use it — if nothing happens, record another combination.
settings.reset_done: Defaults restored (model, dictionary and history kept)
errors.mic.unavailable.action: Pick another input device in Settings or check that the microphone is connected.
errors.mic.permission.text: Windows did not allow access to the microphone.
errors.mic.permission.action: Settings > Privacy > Microphone: allow desktop apps, then try again.
errors.mic.busy.text: The microphone is busy in another program.
errors.mic.busy.action: Close the program that uses it and try again.
errors.model.memory.text: There is not enough memory for the model.
errors.model.memory.action: Choose a smaller model in Settings and restart the service.
errors.model.network.text: The model could not be downloaded.
errors.model.network.action: Check the network and try again; models already downloaded work offline.
errors.model.load.action: Open the logs folder from the tray and try another model.
errors.recognition.failed.text: The recording could not be recognized.
errors.recognition.failed.action: Dictate again; if it repeats, open the logs folder from the tray.
errors.file.read.text: The file could not be read.
errors.file.read.action: Check that the file exists and is a JSON list of terms.
settings.save_failed: Could not save settings - see the log
doctor.title: VibeForma diagnostics
doctor.note: No dictated text or window titles in this report.
